newsitem.title: USA: U.S. March S&P 500 rallies late, ends higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. March S&P 500 rallies late, ends higher.

text.p: Feb 11 - U.S. March S&P 500s extended rallied to set a new session high late and close near the highs. Traders called market nervous, but noted recovery in Nasdaq plus the idea S&Ps much more resilient than the tech sector. One technician said he expects contract highs by week's end. Others said 796.00 still resistance.
